rv.q: This is a strong two-hander about the consequences of being old before your time.
This is a story of a pair of teenagers crying out for control in uncontrollable circumstances, told through two gut-wrenching performances and cohesive, layered writing.
It’s a work well deserving of its flowers.

cn.t: Critics praise *The Silence and the Noise* as a compelling, emotionally charged drama, highlighting its tender yet aggressive exploration of drug addiction and strong characterisation from its two young leads.
